matches.note: Jade "The Blade" wore Dragon Hart down with a Northern Lights suplex and a brainbuster before finishing him with a reverse piledriver.

The fight spilled to the floor, where Trauma suplexed Milenko onto the guardrail and hit an inverted DDT on the concrete; a masked ally, Coma, then clubbed Milenko with brass knuckles so Trauma could finish him with the Flatline.
Dog with Rabies's debut ended quickly with a Brain Buster.
"Outstanding" Brad Randal finished Craig Jones with a leaping piledriver.

matches.title: naw-1998-world-tag-team
matches.note: The Homicidal Maniacs' first defense of the World Tag Team Championship, won by disqualification the week before; Psycho Killer struck Pain with a chair, and Rude Ray and Steve the Stud, the Midnight Strikers, took the belts.

matches.title: naw-1998-world-heavyweight
matches.note: The main event for the World Heavyweight Championship. Jade "The Blade" ran in with a chair meant for Vickens and hit champion Deathwish instead; Vickens locked on the Muscle Hustle cobra clutch for the submission and the title.

matches.note: The Lone Ranger won with a Hurracanrana.
Alex "Blitz" Windhelm submitted Bug with the Blitzkrieg in twenty seconds.
The Dallas Connection beat the Towers of Power; James Harper finished John Huntsman with a Drive By.
The New Generation beat the Booger Brothers; Havok pinned Snot with the Gendrop.
Rob Stryker won with the Superstryke.

matches.title: naw-1998-cruiserweight
matches.note: Champion Jeff "The Machine" Keenan defended the Cruiserweight Championship; Bill Bob Woijicowski ran in and struck Keenan with a chair, letting Mad Goat finish him with Earth's Fury for the title.
"Playboy" Tony Flint won with the Playboy's Dream.

matches.title: naw-1998-tag-team
matches.note: The Bladeliners retained the Tag Team Championship against the Widow Makers; Jade finished Rorschach Nishimura with the Blade Liner.

matches.title: naw-1998-east-coast
matches.note: Champion "Human Torture Rack" Ian Walsh defended the East Coast Championship; Dennis Windham landed a low blow and finished him with the Texas Death Drop for the title.
